div.head: I Cn 10.1
div.ab: ⁊ se þe hine ofer þæne dæg healde agyfe hine þam bisceope ⁊ forgylde hine XI siðan ⁊ ðam cingce CXX scyll'.
⁊ se þe hine ofer þonne dæg healde, agife hine þam biscope ⁊ forgilde hine endlifan syþan ⁊ þam cyninge twa hundred ⁊ twentig scill'.
Qui sine licentia supertenebit eum, reddat episcopo et undecies persoluat et regi CXX solid'.
⁊ se þe hine ofer þæne dæg healde agyfe hine þam bisceope ⁊ forgylde hine XI siðan ⁊ ðam cingce CXX scyll'.
And se ðe hine ofer þæne dæg healde, agyfe hine þam bisceope and forgylde hine XI siðan and ðam cingce CXX scyllinga.
Und wer sie über diesen Tag hinaus vorenthält, zahle sie dem Bischof und vergelte sie [ihm] elffach, und dem König 120 (220 A) Schill.
And whoever withholds it beyond that day, let him pay it to the bishop and pay it [to him] elevenfold, and the king 120 (220, A) shillings.
And he who withholds them beyond that date shall give them up to the bishop, and repeat the payment eleven times, and [pay] 120 shillings to the king.
And anyone who withholds it beyond that day shall give the money to the bishop, and do so again eleven times over, and one hundred twenty shillings to the king.
